Card Q&A.q: I have a Digimon with this card and a face-down card in its digivolution cards. When I activate EX9-070 [Meat]'s  effect and digivolve that Digimon, is the digivolution cost reduced by 3 when combined with this card's inherited effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with face-down digivolution cards would digivolve into a [Ver.3] trait Digimon card, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
